title: 180-Degree Rule
description: Keeps the camera on one side of the action axis so screen direction stays consistent. Recorded facts — Rule: 180-Degree Rule; Purpose: spatial orientation; Break symptom: characters appear to swap sides. Used by directors, editors, script supervisors, and VFX teams to keep audiences immersed.
demo:
# 180-Degree Rule — runnable demo (python3)
# 180-Degree Rule - axis side check (python3)
a=45
b=50
tol=30
same_side=(a < 180) == (b < 180)
within=abs(a-b) <= tol
print("shot A: %.0f deg, shot B: %.0f deg" % (a, b))
print("AXIS KEPT" if same_side and within else "AXIS CROSSED - reshoot or flip")
